description: Navigating to /studio/ without a session redirects to the login page.
Login form filled with invalid credentials, before submitting.
Server returns login page with an error message after wrong credentials.
Studio hub landing page after successful authentication as admin.
Admin user management page — shows all registered users and their roles.
Connectors dashboard — showing existing connectors or 'no connectors yet' state.
New connector 'My GDrive 8b0946' appears in the connector list with type badge and health dot.
Sync triggered via POST /studio/api/connectors/{id}/sync — returns ok:true. Background task starts; sync_runs record created immediately.
After sync completes (success or error), the sync run history table shows the run with connector name, trigger type, result status, and duration.
Admin user can access the /studio/connectors page — sees full UI with Add button.
After logout, session is cleared and user is redirected to the login page.
Viewer role is denied access to /studio/connectors — server returns 403 Forbidden.
Viewer can still access the studio hub — role restriction applies only to sensitive pages (connectors) not the general dashboard.
Studio hub — shows all configured use-cases with their current phase, LoRA version, and PRS score. Entry point for monitoring each UC.
Use-case detail page for 'usecase1_customer_support' — shows pipeline phase, PRS history chart, LoRA training controls, and live sync status.
Connectors page showing both the connector list and the sync run history table. History auto-refreshes every 5 seconds via SSE polling.
Raw JSON from GET /studio/api/sync-runs — the data source powering the sync history table. Each record has connector_id, trigger, status, files_done, duration.
